entities.name: Shimabara Rebellion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Shimabara Rebellion, a transformative movement in Macau (1622–1700). Emerged from Macau serves as the base for Jesuit missions — Matteo Ricci departs for Beijing and Portuguese establish permanent settlement at Macau with tacit Ming permission. Catalyzed Dutch Attacks and Japan Trade Loss.
